title: The Fast Trick to Multiply Any Number by 11
description: A simple mental-math shortcut for multiplying two-digit numbers by 11 — add the digits, slot the sum in the middle. Great for anyone learning basic multiplication tricks.
narration_lines: Multiplying by 11? Here's a fast trick.
First, add the two digits together. 5 plus 4 is 9.
Now slot that 9 right between the original digits.
